verdict.rationale: Portkey's gateway documents automatic retries of failed LLM requests with exponential backoff, plus a configurable `use_retry_after_headers` option that honors provider retry-after headers. That is a first-party, configurable retry policy for transient provider errors. missing for 10: documented control over retry attempt counts and which status codes trigger a retry, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can set automatic retry policies for transient provider errors

citations.quote: Automatically retry failed LLM requests with exponential backoff.
Enable `use_retry_after_headers` to use the provider’s `retry-after-ms`, `x-ms-retry-after-ms`, or `retry-after` headers instead of exponential backoff.
